freeze_notes: Expected routing was authored before execution.
This suite targets browser-driven UI enrichment and lexical false-positive risk.
Do not tune resolver, frontend-ui, testing, or expected labels after first execution.

scenarios.description: Reference dashboard design reconstruction without durable test requirement.
scenarios.task: Open the reference analytics dashboard in a browser, inspect its spacing, typography, navigation density, component hierarchy, and responsive behavior, then rebuild a similar dashboard screen in the existing project without copying its logo or marketing copy.

scenarios.description: Current rendered app inspection for responsive overflow and accessibility structure.
scenarios.task: Run the local settings page in a browser, inspect screenshots plus the DOM and accessibility tree, then fix the modal overflow and focus order problems visible on mobile.

scenarios.description: Screenshot reference used for navigation layout adaptation.
scenarios.task: Use the provided mobile navigation screenshot as a reference, extract the reusable layout and interaction pattern, and adapt our existing navigation component to match the visual rhythm across small and desktop viewports.

scenarios.description: Visual comparison and iteration on existing UI.
scenarios.task: Compare the local profile page against the approved visual reference in the browser, adjust layout, colors, spacing, and empty-state treatment, then re-check the rendered result visually.

scenarios.description: Reference UI reconstruction plus durable browser regression.
scenarios.task: Inspect the reference website in a browser, capture the dashboard screenshot, reconstruct the UI in this app, then add Playwright tests for the accepted desktop and mobile behavior.

scenarios.description: Responsive UI fix with browser regression protection.
scenarios.task: Fix the checkout form that collapses badly on narrow screens, verify the rendered browser behavior, and add a browser regression test so the submit flow and field errors stay usable.

scenarios.description: Accessibility inspection followed by durable interaction coverage.
scenarios.task: Inspect the rendered accessibility tree for the onboarding wizard, repair missing labels and focus traps, and add E2E coverage for keyboard navigation through the wizard.

scenarios.description: Interactive UI pattern plus navigation regression.
scenarios.task: Rebuild the interactive sidebar from the reference design, preserve our route wiring, verify hover and active states in the browser, and add Playwright coverage for navigation state.

scenarios.description: Pure browser regression coverage for existing behavior.
scenarios.task: Add Playwright browser regression tests for the existing checkout journey, covering navigation, form submission, and web-first assertions without changing the UI implementation.

scenarios.description: Stabilizing existing browser tests rather than redesigning UI.
scenarios.task: Stabilize the flaky browser E2E login tests by replacing brittle selectors with user-facing locators, deterministic setup, and better trace artifacts.

scenarios.description: Visual regression testing for accepted page behavior.
scenarios.task: Add focused visual regression checks for the already-approved settings page states, using the project's existing browser test tooling and avoiding broad snapshot churn.

scenarios.description: Explicit agent-browser specialist should outrank generic frontend-ui.
scenarios.task: Use agent-browser to inspect the reference dashboard UI, capture browser screenshots, and map the reusable visual layout into this project.

scenarios.description: Browser wording in HTTP client behavior should not activate frontend-ui.
scenarios.task: Fix the outbound HTTP client bug where our custom browser user-agent header is rejected by the partner API, and keep retry and timeout behavior bounded.

scenarios.description: Browser cache symptom but API header contract root concern.
scenarios.task: Correct the API cache-control headers that cause stale browser responses after profile updates, and document the response contract for clients.

scenarios.description: Playwright browser package upgrade is dependency tooling, not browser test authoring.
scenarios.task: Upgrade the Playwright browser package versions and lockfile entries to resolve the CI install warning, without changing any test assertions.

scenarios.description: Browser user-agent data processing should not become UI work.
scenarios.task: Normalize browser user-agent strings in the monthly analytics import, deduplicate malformed rows, and keep the batch job resumable.

scenarios.description: Screenshot export job is file/data processing, not UI reconstruction.
scenarios.task: Fix the nightly job that generates screenshots of PDF invoices for audit exports, including retry handling for malformed documents.

scenarios.description: Visualize query plan should route to performance/database.
scenarios.task: Visualize the database query plan for the slow revenue report, identify the missing index, and measure the performance improvement.

scenarios.description: Reference website docs with visual diagram should not trigger UI implementation.
scenarios.task: Use the vendor reference website to update our architecture docs with a visual sequence diagram and clearer service-boundary explanation.

scenarios.description: Database consistency regression guard without browser vocabulary.
scenarios.task: Make the wallet debit and ledger insert atomic under concurrent requests, and prevent duplicate settlement records.

scenarios.description: Performance/database routing regression guard.
scenarios.task: Find and fix the N+1 query in the customer list, add the missing index if needed, and measure query count before and after.

scenarios.description: Direct security routing regression guard.
scenarios.task: Review the admin impersonation flow for authorization bypass, session leakage, and unsafe audit logging.
